_about: What a running jl4-service published for the two sources below, captured 2026-11-17 from a jl4-service built from unstable 35aa3bd67 (l4 deploy --server; GET /deployments/{id}?functions=full, the `parameters` of the function in `metadata.functions`, which is what the sidebar gets for a deployed rule; GET /deployments/{id}/openapi.json, the evaluation request body's `arguments` schema; POST /deployments/{id}/.mcp tools/list, the tool's inputSchema). Recorded, not live: regenerate it the same way if the schema shape changes. `starter` has a record input, an enumerated input and an input whose name has a space. `quirk` has an input named alias, which the OpenAPI document leaves out of `properties` and keeps in `required`.

starter.source:
DECLARE Colour IS ONE OF Red, Green

@desc A person
DECLARE Person HAS
  name IS A STRING
  age  IS A NUMBER TYPICALLY 18

@export default Describe a starter
GIVEN `start year` IS A NUMBER @desc The year the person starts
      shade        IS A Colour TYPICALLY Green
      who          IS A Person @desc The starter
GIVETH A NUMBER
describe MEANS
  IF shade EQUALS Green THEN `start year` PLUS who's age ELSE 0

quirk.source:
@export default echo
GIVEN alias IS A NUMBER
GIVETH A NUMBER
echo MEANS alias
